title: Instagram Influencer Analyzer Input
description: Rank creators by engagement rate, flag sponsored posts, track brand mentions. Pick a content type, paste Instagram URLs or a search query, and run. Posts, reels, comments, mentions, profiles, hashtags, places, and user search in one actor.

contentType.title: Content to scrape
contentType.description: What kind of data you want. Each type expects a matching URL or search query.
enumTitles: Posts (from profile, post URL, or hashtag)
Reels (from profile, reel URL, or hashtag)
Profile info + engagement metrics (from profile URL)
Hashtag volume (from hashtag URL or search query)
Place details (from location URL or search query)

urls.title: Instagram URLs
urls.description: Instagram URLs to scrape. URLs take priority over search queries and cannot be combined. Use /p/ for posts, /reel/ for reels, /username/ for profiles, /explore/tags/ for hashtags, /explore/locations/ for places.

searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Keywords to search (hashtags, users, or places depending on content type). Enter multiple terms as separate items. Ignored when URLs are provided.
searchQueries.sectionCaption: Search by query instead of URLs

resultsLimit.title: Results limit per URL
resultsLimit.description: Cap on results returned per URL or query. Controls cost and runtime.

filterByDate.title: Filter by date
filterByDate.description: Only return posts newer than this date. UTC, not local time. Format YYYY-MM-DD for absolute, or a relative like '7 days ago', '1 month ago'. Leave blank for no filter.

includeEngagementMetrics.title: Include engagement rate + posting cadence
includeEngagementMetrics.description: On profile and hashtag runs, compute avg likes per post, avg comments per post, engagement rate as a percentage of followers, and posts per week. Built in. No extra cost.

detectSponsoredPosts.title: Flag sponsored and paid partnership posts
detectSponsoredPosts.description: Mark each post with isSponsored true or false based on #ad, #sponsored, #paidpartnership, Instagram's paid partnership label, and brand tag patterns. Built in. No extra cost.

downloadMedia.title: Download images and videos
downloadMedia.description: Save every image and video to the key value store and include a downloadUrl per post. Adds storage cost.

scrapeCommentsPerPost.title: Also scrape top comments per post
scrapeCommentsPerPost.description: Pull the top N comments from each post or reel in the run. 0 disables. Only runs for posts and reels content types.

includeMediaMetadata.title: Include image dimensions, alt text, and location
includeMediaMetadata.description: Enrich each row with width, height, alt text (accessibility caption), and tagged location when available.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate across runs
dedupe.description: Skip post and profile IDs already pushed in previous runs. Turn off to refresh counts on the same items.

maxItemsTotal.title: Max items per run
maxItemsTotal.description: Hard cap across all URLs and queries. Controls total cost.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential strongly recommended. Instagram blocks datacenter IPs aggressively.
